name: Twinblade Flurry
flavor:
Two short blades, worked in turn, as the weald's sellswords used them.

Too poor for a shield and too proud to carry a Warden's, they were hired for the Bastion's narrow gates. It is said part of their wage was paid in marks rather than coin: a right to the city's warmth.

Those who refused the mark are the ones who tell of it.
